application.name: Normals and Planes
application.description: Surface normals and planes on the GPU with holoscan-normals: a synthetic depth camera in a known room is deprojected by holoscan-point-cloud's DepthToPointCloudOp, NormalEstimationOp estimates every point's normal and curvature and PlaneSegmentationOp finds the planes and labels every pixel, every frame checked against the room's truth, and HoloViz shows the normals color-mapped beside the plane labels.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-normals demo, with a synthetic room, a ground-truth reporter and a HoloViz view.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

synthetic.description: Estimate the normals and planes of 300 frames of the synthetic room, check each against its truth, and show the normals and planes when a display is available.

ci.description: Finite headless check: 30 synthetic 640x480 frames; the normals' angle error on the inside of every surface, the curvature of the sphere against the flat surfaces, and the floor, both walls and the table top among the planes, checked against the truth.
